Set the title to **خم میں** and the Roman title to **Khum Mein**, switched the direction to right-to-left, and removed `noUrdu`. Rendered “Buzar” as **بوذر** and “Zee Alhajj” as **ذی الحجہ**. Only the selected lyric was edited.
